testcase.name: refresh success replaces the unavailable state with device location
bearing calculation remains unchanged for Aleppo
refresh failure without cached bearing clears loading and reports location error
refreshing a manual location must not relabel it as a device fix
initial unavailable location produces a location-specific error
saved location makes the first bearing immediately usable
later location failure cannot remove an existing usable bearing
manual location uses the canonical manual source label
alignment uses enter and exit hysteresis around the current bearing
